name: record-chip
title: Record Chip
description: A pill that shows the record something belongs to and picks another: icon, name and a chevron as a picker trigger, plus an arrow link to the record — or, as the ghost variant, a property value that reads as plain text.

meta.whenToUse: Linking a record to another one in its header — a meeting's customer or project — with a picker and a jump to the linked record.
meta.whenNotToUse: A free-form tag (Chip) or a form field with a label (Combobox, Select).
